name: SAM FITNESS
address: Tasheel Building - Shop # 9 8th St - near Metro Bus stop - Al Qusais Ind. Fourth - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Sam Fitness is a premium fitness center located in Al Qusais, Dubai, offering a modern training environment with state-of-the-art equipment, certified trainers, personal training, strength and conditioning, weight loss programs, bodybuilding, and functional fitness. We are committed to helping members achieve their fitness goals through professional guidance, quality facilities, and exceptional customer service in a clean, motivating, and welcoming atmosphere.

reviews.author: Nizamudeen Rafee
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience with this gym and its customer service.

I paid AED 300 for a 3-month membership. on May 2026. The very next day, due to health reasons, i informed the staff member who enrolled me that I would not be able to start immediately and requested that the membership be put on hold. The staff member confirmed to my brother-in-law (who is also the member of the same gym )that the membership had been placed on hold. Based on this confirmation, I understood that the membership was inactive.

I did not use the gym even for a single day.

Yesterday (22 July 2026), when I contacted the gym to resume my membership, another staff member informed me that the membership had remained active and that only nine days were left. I was also told that the staff member who handled the original request is no longer working there.

I understand that mistakes can happen, but customers should not be held responsible for internal communication issues or staff errors. I paid for a service that was never used, and we expected the gym to take responsibility and provide a fair solution.

The way my concern was handled was also very disappointing. The staff member who spoke to me was unhelpful and unprofessional. He said 300 is gone. When I requested the manager’s contact details and mentioned raising a complaint, the response was dismissive, which made the situation even more frustrating.

I hope the management reviews this matter seriously and improves their customer service and internal processes. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this gym unless they address such issues and treat customers with more care and accountability.

reviews.author: Salman Bin sakkariya
reviews.text:
Sam Fitness is a calm and peaceful gym, especially in the morning with no rush, perfect for focused workouts. The gym is well-equipped with high-quality machines like Panatta, Life Fitness, and Cybex. There are plenty of leg machines such as hack squat, pendulum squat, leg extension, leg curl, butt kicks, adductor, abductor, standing calf raise, and seated calf raise. Great for training even minor muscles.

The staff, especially Jacob. He is very friendly, professional and always available in the morning to help with any doubts. The founder, Sam, a former army captain as well as a great bodybuilder. He has great knowledge and passion for fitness.
Highly recommended for anyone serious about training💪.

reviews.author: Richard Alexander
reviews.text:
I recently joined Sam Fitness, and even though it's far from both my room and my office—it takes almost 2.5 hours to get here—I never saw the distance as a problem. When your goal is big, no distance feels too long. After all, success demands commitment, sacrifice, and hard work—and I’m all in.

What truly makes it worth the journey is the environment here. The trainers are experienced and genuinely supportive (Anup, Mirza, Ali, Jacob)That’s exactly why I chose Sam Fitness—because I’m here to prepare for a natural bodybuilding competition, and I believe that under the guidance of Sam (Saddam), I’ll soon turn this dream into reality.

My sincere wish is that one day Sam Fitness grows far beyond boundaries—not just in dubai but across the world, so that young aspiring athletes can find the right guidance and don’t lose their way chasing fitness goals.

Sam Fitness is more than a gym—it’s a vision, a community, and a path toward greatness

Here, strangers become allies in the shared pursuit of becoming—better, faster, braver. They are more than instructors; they are mentors who see potential where others see plateaus, who ignite fire in weary souls with a blend of wisdom and unwavering belief. Their hands guide not just bodies but hearts, turning doubt into determination with a rallying cry or a quiet word. They celebrate victories as if they were their own, yet remain steadfast through every stumble, reminding us that progress is not linear—it’s a dance of patience and persistence. Together, the gym and its trainers are a testament to the beauty of human potential.
